title: Form-view FormField.visibleOn (CEL) is never evaluated — conditional fields always render
body:
## Symptom

A form view section field with a CEL \`visibleOn\` predicate is always visible. Showcase repro (framework \`examples/app-showcase/src/views/task.view.ts\`):

\`\`\`ts
{ field: 'notes', visibleOn: P`record.priority == 'urgent'`, colSpan: 2 }
\`\`\`

The server meta correctly ships \`"visibleOn": {"dialect":"cel","source":"record.priority == 'urgent'"}\` (verified via \`GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task\` → \`.formViews.default.sections[0].fields[6]\`), but the notes field renders even when priority = Low. Field-level \`visibleWhen\`/\`readonlyWhen\`/\`requiredWhen\` all work — only the view-level \`FormField.visibleOn\` is dead.

## Root cause — the chain is broken in three places

Console edit path: \`AppContent\` → \`ModalForm\` (+ \`resolveFormViewLayout\` sections) → \`buildSectionFields\` (\`packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts\`) → SchemaRenderer \`type:'form'\` → \`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx\`.

1. **Object shape silently dropped** — \`sectionFields.ts\` \`attachVisibility()\` (line 45) and \`ObjectForm.tsx\` \`normalizeVisibility()\` (line 411) only accept \`typeof expr === 'string'\`. The spec \`P\`-template wire shape is \`{dialect:'cel', source}\` → predicate never attached.
2. **The evaluator isn't CEL** — even for a string expr, the attached \`visible(formData)\` calls \`evaluateCondition()\` (\`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:1833\`), which only understands legacy \`{field, operator, value}\` objects and returns \`true\` for any unknown format ("Default to true").
3. **Nothing consumes the predicate anyway** — no renderer in the form chain ever calls \`FormField.visible(formData)\`; \`form.tsx:538\` destructures \`visibleOn\` out of the field config and drops it on the floor.

Meanwhile the *working* field-level rules go through the canonical engine: \`resolveFieldRuleState\`/\`evalFieldPredicate\` (\`packages/core/src/evaluator/fieldRules.ts\`), which already accepts \`string | {dialect, source}\` and binds \`record\` scope via \`@objectstack/formula\` ExpressionEngine (ADR-0036: no private expression DSL).

## Fix direction

Route view-level \`FormField.visibleOn\` through the same canonical engine:
- \`form.tsx\`: evaluate \`visibleOn\` with \`evalFieldPredicate\` against the live \`ruleRecord\` (fail-open), both at field render and in the stale-error-clearing effect.
- \`sectionFields.ts\`: carry \`visibleOn\` (string **or** \`{dialect, source}\`) through \`normalizeSectionField\` instead of attaching a dead \`visible()\` closure; also carry field-level \`visibleWhen\`/\`readonlyWhen\`/\`requiredWhen\` from object-schema metadata so sectioned forms honor them like flat forms do.
- \`types/form.ts\`: widen \`FormField.visibleOn\` to the spec Expression shape.

Found while dogfooding the framework app-showcase (list/form capability audit, P0-16).
